scene: At the skate booth, a attendant points out three waiting transit lines.
picture: A flat side view along a polished promenade. On the far left, an open brass spiral lift waits on a pillar. At centre, a red mountain cable tram rests on raised rails. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands right of centre talking to a clerk at the skate rental booth. Far right, a moored gondola floats.
shown: a glowing spiral lift cage sitting open on the far left
a red mountain cable tram idling with open doors at centre
a striped garden gondola moored on water on the far right
